_note: WAISentry pre-approved containment playbooks and the Kitewing runbook (fictional client; demo values). Every action is simulated.

pre_approval.scope: Google Workspace identities, OAuth apps and Drive files of kitewing.example that are in a confirmed incident's blast radius
rules: A certified Wursta analyst confirms the incident before any playbook runs
Only the four playbooks below run without asking the client; everything else is escalated
Targets must be in the incident's blast radius
PB-01, PB-02 and PB-03 need severity high or critical; PB-04 needs medium or higher
At most 3 suspended accounts per incident, for at most 4 hours; never super admins or the break-glass account
Allowlisted (sanctioned) apps are never revoked without client approval
Nothing is ever deleted: accounts, files and mail stay intact and every action can be rolled back

playbooks.name: Instant web session termination
playbooks.action: Sign the user out of every web and mobile session and revoke their OAuth and app-password tokens
playbooks.api: Admin SDK Directory API: users.signOut + tokens.delete
playbooks.rollback: none needed — the user signs in again with their security key
playbooks.notify: user's manager and the client on-call

playbooks.name: OAuth application revocation
playbooks.action: Revoke the app's tokens for every user who granted it and block its client id tenant-wide
playbooks.api: Admin SDK Directory API: tokens.delete per user + API controls: block the client id
playbooks.limits: apps in the blast radius; never an allowlisted app
playbooks.rollback: client admin can unblock the client id
playbooks.notify: affected users and the client on-call

playbooks.name: Targeted account suspension
playbooks.action: Suspend the account for a fixed window so nobody can sign in while the password is reset
playbooks.api: Admin SDK Directory API: users.update suspended=true (auto-unsuspend scheduled)
playbooks.limits: max 3 accounts per incident; max 4 hours; never super admins or break-glass
playbooks.rollback: automatic at the end of the window, or earlier when the client confirms
playbooks.notify: user's manager and the client on-call

playbooks.name: Drive access quarantine
playbooks.action: Remove 'anyone with the link' and external user/domain permissions from the incident's files; internal access is untouched; files are never deleted
playbooks.api: Drive API: permissions.delete (previous permissions recorded for restore)
playbooks.rollback: one-click restore of the recorded permissions
playbooks.notify: file owner and the client on-call

not_pre_approved.action: Device or network isolation (EDR console or switch port)
not_pre_approved.owner: client IT (Noah Kim; Millbrook: Hugo Laurent) — recommended for the next pre-approval review

not_pre_approved.action: Domain or sender block in DNSFilter / Mimecast
Remove a mail filter or forwarding address
Hold a payment or verify vendor bank details

escalation_matrix.critical: P1 — page the on-call certified analyst now; phone the client on-call (Noah Kim) — runbook target 15 min; payment fraud also Marcus Bell
escalation_matrix.high: P2 — phone the client on-call — runbook target 30 min
escalation_matrix.medium: P3 — ticket and email in the next business hour
